target_customer: Construction contractors, and aggregate and ready-mix producers, that buy and sell bulk construction materials
problem: Ordering, ticketing and paying for bulk construction materials runs on phone calls, paper tickets and manual reconciliation.
business_model: SaaS plus marketplace with embedded financing and fintech

founders.name: Anthony Valente
previous_startups: WheresMyConcrete (exited to a public strategic buyer, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a 3x founder in marketplaces, construction and logistics and a full-stack developer (Rails, React, Ionic); only active founder listed.

competitors.name: Agora (later Kojo)
competitors.what: Materials procurement platform for trade contractors
competitors.funding_then: a profile site lists a $33M Series B in 2021; not confirmed by a press release I opened

technical_complexity.rationale: Ordering, ticketing and reconciliation workflows with integrations into supplier systems and a financing layer; standard SaaS with some hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Two-sided supplier and contractor network plus founder experience in concrete logistics; thin evidence of lock-in yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an acquisition or copying of Concord; procurement rivals kept raising money (Agora Series B 2021, Kojo Series C 2022).

market_need_then: Construction materials buying was heavily manual and fragmented; the founder previously built a concrete delivery tracking business, indicating firsthand demand.

branding.domain_note: Uses concordmaterials.com, a long compound domain; history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Not verified; the live site returned only a title when fetched.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand pages found; the website text was nearly empty when fetched, and the name overlaps with many other Concord companies.

outcome_analysis: Concord Materials was founded in 2020 by a founder who had already exited a concrete logistics startup, and joined YC in Summer 2021. Public information is thin: no verifiable funding round, shutdown or sale was found, and the company is still listed as active with about seven people. The outcome cannot be judged from public sources.
notes: Aggregators disagree: CB Insights lists 280K USD over 6 rounds including a MassChallenge accelerator round dated 2021-09-26, and Startupintros lists a 2M seed in Aug 2021; neither is backed by a primary source, so no round is recorded. Extruct lists YC, Twelve and FJ Labs as investors (aggregator only). The Agora competitor entry is dated only to 2021 from a search result title and a profile claim; Agora rebranded to Kojo in May 2022. Competitor list is small because 2021 sources were scarce.
